angle: Movement translation across all five groups: the same movement (first 1.5 s from rest) in the matching Combine position drill and on random NFL pass plays; does drill-to-game translation explain production beyond pick? DL chosen as the clearest of a 27-cell pre-screen.
metric_name: Carry-Over %: 100 x a player's mean speed over the first 1.5 s of random NFL snaps (alignment-adjusted) / the same from his Combine position-drill reps (drill x year adjusted); DL = pass-rush drill vs NFL pass rush
headline_number: DL Carry-Over vs pressure rate: partial rho 0.26 [-0.03, 0.46] beyond log pick, weight, EDGE share and class (n=68, nominal p 0.035, family-wise p 0.822 over 27 cells); 0.7 extra pressures a season per sd [-0.3, 1.9] vs 2.4 for pick 100 -> 30; out-of-class R2 gain 0.010 [-0.231, 0.143], positive in 35% of bootstraps; the NFL half carries it (0.17) while the drill half is noise (rep-to-rep 0.04, drill->game 0.07).
what_changed_from_previous: New candidate on the translation angle (closest prior: round_04/cand_3 DL Launch, 7.51, flagged for a jargon-heavy null opening and a 1,966-word stats-heavy body). (1) Translation tested on the matched movement for all five groups (pass-rush get-off, kick-slide pass set, back-pedal start, WR/TE release) with one function and one named ratio, before choosing a group; (2) 27-cell screen with within-class permutation family-wise p, stated once; (3) decomposition of the ratio into its NFL and Combine halves, so the label is not oversold; (4) circularity check (NFL curve without pressure plays), alignment, window and NGS/10-yd-split baselines; (5) leave-one-class-out R2 with class-stratified bootstrap and per-class rho; (6) named-player table (top 5 / bottom 5) and six-player small multiples of drill reps vs NFL rushes; (7) new confounder lesson: OL kick-slide 'signal' (0.44) is tackle vs guard/center (0.14 after T/G/C share); (8) plain opening of about 70 words, statistics in one appendix paragraph, 1,885 words, 6 figures + 2 tables, every decimal in numbers.json (unique keys, put() raises on duplicates), script runs in about 45 s.
open_risks: Headline is a weak lead: family-wise p 0.822 and out-of-class gain positive in only 35% of bootstraps; judges have penalized nulls
Carry-Over is mostly the NFL half (Carry-Over beyond NFL speed 0.07), so it is a pro-personnel descriptor, not a Combine forecast; the prospective rookie-snap test is impossible (n=11)
Lead is concentrated in the single-season 2025 class (0.52 vs 0.19 and 0.17)
TE drill-to-game correlation is -0.53 at n=23, unexplained beyond role mixing
No blockers/ball in game tracking: contact and win type are inferred, not observed; overlaps the Hoop G DL line only in using the same pressure outcome
